title: Vegan Breakfast Boost Toast
description: A delicious and nutritious breakfast option made with whole grain toast, topped with a vibrant and healthy vegan spread.

ingredients.name: Whole Grain Bread
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free option if needed

ingredients.name: Vegan Spread
ingredients.notes: Choose a brand that suits your taste

ingredients.name: Boost Powder
ingredients.notes: Mix according to the package instructions

ingredients.name: Fresh Fruit
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite berries or sliced citrus

ingredients.name: Nuts or Seeds
ingredients.notes: Select your preferred nut or seed for added crunch

instructions: 1. Toast the slices of whole grain bread until lightly browned.
2. Spread 1 tablespoon of the vegan spread on each toasted slice.
3. Sprinkle 1/2 teaspoon of the Boost powder on top of each slice.
4. Arrange the fresh fruit on top of the spread.
5. Sprinkle the nuts or seeds over the fruit for added crunch.
